question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The central bank must aggressively tighten its monetary policy without further delay. || II. Persistent core inflation will spiral out of control and wipe out middle-class savings. || Question: Which connector(s) correctly combine the statements?
explanation: Statements I aur II ke beech condition aur negative result ka relation hai. Agar RBI ne policy tight nahi ki, toh inflation badh jayega. 'Lest' ka matlab hota hai 'kahi aisa na ho ki' (negative warning) aur 'Otherwise' ka matlab hai 'warna'. Dono is situation mein fit baithte hain. Connected sentence: The central bank must aggressively tighten its monetary policy without further delay, otherwise persistent core inflation will spiral out of control.
trick: Jab ek action ko turant karna ho taaki doosra bura action na ho, toh 'Lest' ya 'Otherwise' dhoondo. 'Therefore' aur 'Consequently' result batate hain.
tip: 'Lest' ke baad humesha 'should' ya V1 form aata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The fiscal deficit widened to an alarming 6.4 percent of the GDP this financial year. || II. The central government managed to sustain its ambitious capital expenditure program. || Question: Which connector(s) correctly combine the statements?
explanation: Yahan contradiction (virodhabhas) dikh raha hai. Deficit (ghata) badhne ke bawajood, sarkar ne apna kharcha jaari rakha. 'Notwithstanding' (ke bawajood) aur 'Even though' (bhale hi) dono virodhabhas dikhane ke liye use hote hain. Connected sentence: Even though the fiscal deficit widened to an alarming 6.4 percent, the government managed to sustain its program.
trick: Negative event (deficit) aur positive outcome (sustained capex) ek sath ho toh contradiction wale words (Despite, Although, Notwithstanding) choose karein.
tip: Contradiction sentences mein 'Hence' ya 'Moreover' kaat dijiye.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The subsidy burden on fertilizers will be reduced significantly in the next quarter. || II. Global crude oil prices remain completely below the crucial $80 per barrel mark. || Question: Which connector(s) correctly combine the statements?
explanation: Statement I tabhi sach hoga jab Statement II ki shart puri hogi. 'Provided that' aur 'Assuming that' dono ka matlab 'basarte ki' ya 'is shart par' hota hai. Connected sentence: The subsidy burden will be reduced significantly provided that global crude oil prices remain below the $80 mark.
trick: Jab action kisi condition par nirbhar ho, toh 'Provided that' lagta hai. 'Unless' negative condition ke liye hota hai, jo yahan meaning badal dega.
tip: 'Provided that' positive conditions ko link karne ke kaam aata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The monsoon distribution was highly erratic and severely impacted the Kharif crop sowing. || II. Rural aggregate demand is expected to remain sluggish throughout the festive season. || Question: Which connector(s) correctly combine the statements?
explanation: Statement I ka direct nateeja (result) Statement II hai. Kharab monsoon ke kaaran rural demand kamzor rahegi. Isliye 'Consequently' aur 'Hence' (jisparinaamsvaroop / isliye) bilkul sahi hain. Connected sentence: The monsoon distribution was highly erratic; consequently, rural aggregate demand is expected to remain sluggish.
trick: Jab pehla sentence cause ho aur doosra effect, toh 'Consequently', 'Hence', ya 'Therefore' jese result-oriented connectors dhoondo.
tip: 'Albeit' concession batata hai, cause-effect nahi.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The newly drafted labor codes bring much-needed operational flexibility to the manufacturing sector. || II. The actual implementation phase at the state level is expected to be fraught with union protests. || Question: Which connector(s) correctly combine the statements?
explanation: Ek taraf labor codes faydemand hain (positive), par unka lagoo hona mushkil hai (negative). Yeh contrast hai. 'Nevertheless' aur 'Yet' dono ka matlab 'phir bhi' hota hai jo yahan perfect baithega. Connected sentence: The newly drafted labor codes bring flexibility, yet the actual implementation phase is expected to be fraught with protests.
trick: Ek statement positive aur doosra negative ho toh hamesha contrast connectors (Yet, But, Nevertheless) use karein.
tip: 'Nevertheless' hamesha do virodhi baton ko jodta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The proposed national infrastructure pipeline is absolutely crucial for long-term economic growth. || II. It directly addresses the chronic structural bottlenecks in supply chain logistics. || Question: Which connector(s) correctly combine the statements?
explanation: Statement I kyu crucial hai? Kyunki woh structural issues ko solve karta hai (Statement II). Connected sentence: The proposed pipeline is crucial for growth, inasmuch as it addresses the chronic structural bottlenecks.
trick: Jab doosra sentence pehle sentence ka reason de raha ho, toh 'Since', 'Because', ya 'Inasmuch as' options mein check karein.
tip: 'Inasmuch as' ka prayog formal 'because' ki tarah hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. trick: Jab do alag subjects ke alag actions ko compare karte hain, tab 'Whereas' ya 'While' ka use sabse safe hota hai.
tip: 'Whereas' hamesha do virodhi sthitiyo ko dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. trick: Jab do faayde ya nuksaan ek sath diye hon, toh additive connectors jaise 'And', 'Besides', ya 'Not only... but also' dhoondhein.
tip: Addition ke liye 'Besides' ek strong aur formal connector hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. trick: Jab pehle action ka maksad (purpose) doosre statement mein ho, toh 'so that' ya 'in order that' ka use hota hai.
tip: 'In order that' formal sentences mein purpose batane ke liye use karein.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. trick: Jab koi negative consequence rokne ke liye ek shart ho, toh 'Unless' dhoondhein kyu ki usme pehle se hi 'not' chupa hota hai.
tip: 'Unless' wale clause mein dobara 'not' ka use nahi karte.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. explanation: Desh ka vikas tab tak hoga jab tak sarkar invest karti rahegi. 'As long as' (jab tak) aur 'Provided that' (basarte) dono condition ko represent karte hain. Connected sentence: The overall index will improve as long as the government invests higher proportions in healthcare.
trick: Agar doosra positive result pehle continuous action par dependent hai, toh 'As long as' ek dam perfect fit hai.
tip: 'As long as' samay aur shart dono ko dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The honorable finance minister officially announced the much-anticipated corporate tax rate cuts. || II. trick: Past mein back-to-back hone wale actions ke liye hamesha 'No sooner...than' ya 'Hardly...when' ka grammar rule apply karein.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. Urban premium consumption has shown distinct and encouraging signs of a robust V-shaped recovery. || II. Connected sentence: Urban consumption has shown signs of recovery; conversely, rural wage growth remains entirely stagnant.
trick: Jab do statements bilkul opposite disha (direction) mein ja rahe ho, toh 'Conversely' sabse apt connector hota hai.
tip: 'Conversely' ko hamesha semi-colon ya full stop ke baad lagate hain.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The domestic automobile industry witnessed a massive drop in passenger vehicle dispatches. || Question: Which connector(s) correctly combine the statements?
explanation: Statement I karan (cause) hai aur Statement II uska nateeja. 'Owing to' aur 'On account of' dono ka matlab 'ke karan' hota hai. Connected sentence: Owing to an acute shortage of semiconductor chips globally, the domestic automobile industry witnessed a drop in dispatches.
trick: Karan batane wale sentences mein nouns/phrases ko jodte waqt 'Owing to', 'Due to', ya 'On account of' ka istemal hota hai.
tip: 'Owing to' sentence ke shuru mein aa sakta hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. explanation: Pehle statement mein ek choti kami ko maana ja raha hai (concession), par doosre mein bada fayda bataya hai. 'Granted that' (maana ki) aur 'Admitting that' dono concession batate hain. Connected sentence: Granted that the newly introduced slab rationalization might cause short-term hiccups, it will inevitably lead to better compliance.
trick: Jab kisi point ko 'maana ki aisa hai' ke tone mein start karna ho taaki doosra bada point prove ho, 'Granted that' use karein.
tip: 'Granted that' hamesha fact ko acknowledge karne ke liye hota hai.

trick: Jab pehla statement problem bataye aur doosra uska necessary action, toh result/inference wale words (Therefore, Thus, Hence) sahi hote hain.
tip: 'Thus' aur 'Therefore' ka prayog formal conclusions mein hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. trick: Jab ek positive adjective ko modify karte huye ek negative adjective joda jaye, toh 'Albeit' sabse advanced aur sahi word hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. trick: Ek negative halaat mein bhi result positive aana clear-cut virodhabhas hai. Isliye reason batane wale (Hence, Because) options ko reject karein.
tip: 'Notwithstanding' ek formal aur advanced alternative hai 'Despite' ka.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The newly appointed urban planners systematically prioritize expansive pedestrian-friendly zones over traditional multi-lane expressways. || II. The rapidly expanding metropolitan areas will inevitably transform into highly congested, unlivable concrete jungles. || Question: Which connector(s) correctly combine the statements?
explanation: Agar urban planners ne pedestrians ko priority nahi di, toh shehar unlivable ban jayenge. Ye strict warning hai. 'Otherwise' (warna) aur 'Or else' (anyatha) warning denote karte hain. Connected sentence: Planners must prioritize pedestrian-friendly zones, otherwise the metropolitan areas will transform into unlivable concrete jungles.
trick: Agar pehla kaam anivarya (must-do) hai, jiske na hone par doosre hisse mein disaster dikhaya ho, tab sirf 'Otherwise/Or else' lagta hai.
tip: Warnings ko link karne ke liye 'Otherwise' bahut practical aur direct hota hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The apex finance ministry unequivocally classified offshore cryptocurrency trading as a highly speculative and risky asset class. || II. Uninformed retail investors enthusiastically pumped millions into completely unregulated decentralized digital exchanges. || Question: Which connector(s) correctly combine the statements?
explanation: Finance ministry ki strict warning aur classification ke bawajood (contradiction), retail investors ne paisa lagaya. 'Even though' (bhale hi) aur 'Although' (halanki) virodhabhas ko accurately show karte hain. Connected sentence: Even though the finance ministry classified cryptocurrency as highly speculative, retail investors pumped millions into unregulated exchanges.
trick: Sarkar mana kare aur public wahi kaam kare, toh logical sense me 'halanki/bhale hi' lagega. Reason wale words (Therefore, Because) cut kar do.
tip: 'Even though' simple 'Although' ke mukabale jyada strong contrast dikhata hai.

question: Direction: Choose the correct connector(s) from the given options to combine the statements into one single sentence, preserving the original meaning. || I. The state-sponsored sovereign wealth fund methodically divested its entire holding from highly polluting fossil fuel assets. || II. It aggressively realigned its massive core portfolio heavily towards promising next-generation green energy startups. || Question: Which connector(s) correctly combine the statements?
explanation: Wealth fund ne do major eco-friendly decisions liye: fossil fuels se paisa nikala aur green energy mein lagaya. Yeh additional progressive actions hain. 'Not only... but also' (na keval... balki) aur 'Besides' yahan best additive connectors hain. Connected sentence: The wealth fund not only divested from fossil fuel assets but also realigned its portfolio towards green energy startups.
trick: Jab ek sentence kisi acche action ko bata raha ho aur doosra sentence ek aur accha (complementary) action add kare, toh 'Not only... but also' fit hota hai.
tip: Parallel progressive ideas ko add karne mein 'Besides' bohot fluent hota hai.
